SEND.INPUTLOCKED: Cholowera chatsekedwa. Muyenera kutsegula cholowera ichi kuti mugwiritse ntchito.
SEND.ALERTFEECHANGECONTENT: Ndalama zenizeni zogulira ndi zokwera kuposa momwe mukuyembekezera. Chonde tsimikizirani ndalama zatsopano:

CREATECONTRACT.TITLE: Pangani Pangano
CREATECONTRACT.INFO: Gawani mgwirizano wanzeru ku netiweki potumiza bytecode yake yokonzedwa. Iyi ndi ntchito ya unyolo wapakati - onaninso makonda anu a bytecode ndi gasi musanayigwiritse ntchito, kuyigwiritsa ntchito sikungasinthidwe.
CREATECONTRACT.INVALIDBYTECODE: Bytecode iyenera kukhala chingwe chovomerezeka cha hex (0-9, a-f) chokhala ndi zilembo zofanana
CREATECONTRACT.GASPRICE: Mtengo wa Gasi (MRX pa gasi lililonse)
CREATECONTRACT.INCOMPLETEFORM: Chonde sankhani adilesi yotumizira, lembani bytecode yovomerezeka, ndikukhazikitsa malire/mtengo wamafuta wovomerezeka
CREATECONTRACT.HIGHGASPRICEINFO: Mtengo wa mafuta omwe mwakhazikitsa ndi wokwera kwambiri. Kuyika mafuta kumeneku kungawononge ndalama zokwana:

STAKING.NOTENABLEDINSTR: Kuti muyike pa stake muyenera kuyatsa staking setting staking=1 mu fayilo yanu ya metrix.conf.
STAKING.NOTSTAKINGINFO: Chikwama chanu cha ndalama chatsekedwa kuti chisungidwe.
STAKING.NOTSTAKINGINSTR: Mukhoza kuyamba kuyika ndalama zanu potsegula chikwama chanu kuti muyike ndalama zanu

MASTERNODES.NOMNOUTPUTS: Palibe zotsatira za Masternode zomwe zapezeka. Kuti mugwiritse ntchito Masternode yakomweko tumizani ndalama zokwana 2, 5, 25, 50 kapena 100 miliyoni ku adilesi yanu ya Masternode ndikudikirira zitsimikizo 15.

SIGNMESSAGE.SIGN_DESCRIPTION: Mukhoza kusaina mauthenga ndi maadiresi anu kuti mutsimikizire kuti ndinu anu. Samalani kuti musasainire chilichonse chosamveka bwino, chifukwa ziwopsezo za phishing zingayese kukunyengererani kuti musayine dzina lanu kwa iwo. Saini mawu okhawo omwe mukuvomereza.
SIGNMESSAGE.VERIFY_DESCRIPTION: Lowetsani adilesi yosainira, uthenga (onetsetsani kuti mwakopera mizere yosweka, malo, ma tabu, ndi zina zotero) ndi siginecha pansipa kuti mutsimikizire uthengawo. Samalani kuti musawerenge zambiri za siginecha kuposa zomwe zili mu uthenga wosainidwawo, kuti mupewe kunyengedwa ndi munthu amene ali pakati.

ABOUT.NUMBERBLOCKS: Chiwerengero cha mabuloko omwe alipo panopa

DEBUG.CONSOLEINFO: Takulandirani ku Metrix Core RPC console. Lembani thandizo kuti muwone mwachidule malamulo omwe alipo.
DEBUG.CONSOLEWARNING: CHENJEZO: Achinyengo akhala akugwira ntchito, akuuza ogwiritsa ntchito kuti alembe malamulo apa, akuba zomwe zili mu chikwama chawo. Musagwiritse ntchito console iyi popanda kumvetsetsa bwino zotsatira za lamulo.

REPAIR.INFOEXTERNAL: Malamulo okonza awa sangayendetsedwe pamene Metrix Core ikuyendetsedwa kunja
REPAIR.INFO: Mabatani omwe ali pansipa adzayambitsanso Metrix Core ndi njira zoyendetsera ntchito kuti akonze chikwama, kukonza mavuto ndi mafayilo a blockchain owonongeka kapena zochitika zomwe zasowa/zakale.
REPAIR.SALVAGEINFO: -salvagewallet: Kuyesa kupeza makiyi achinsinsi kuchokera ku chikwama cha ndalama chomwe chawonongeka.dat.
REPAIR.RESCANINFO: -scan: Scannso blockchain kuti muwone ngati pali zochitika zomwe zasowa mu chikwama.
REPAIR.RECOVER1INFO: -zapwallettxes=1: Bwezeretsani zochitika kuchokera ku blockchain (sungani meta-data, mwachitsanzo mwini akaunti)
REPAIR.RECOVER2INFO: -zapwallettxes=2: Bwezeretsani zochitika kuchokera ku blockchain (kusiya meta-data)
REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETBUTTON: Sinthani mawonekedwe a chikwama cha ndalama
REPAIR.UPGRADEWALLETINFO: -kukweza chikwama: Sinthani chikwama chanu kukhala mtundu waposachedwa kwambiri pa nthawi yoyambira. (Dziwani: izi SI kusintha kwa chikwama chanu chokha!)
REPAIR.REBUILDINDEXINFO: -reindex: Kumanganso index ya blockchain kuchokera ku mafayilo a blk000??.dat omwe alipo.
REPAIR.BOOTSTRAPINFO: Kutsitsa mafayilo a blockchain a Metrix kuchokera ku metrixcoin.com ndikukhazikitsa pulogalamu yanu. Kutengera ndi kulumikizana kwa netiweki yanu, izi zitha kutenga mphindi 10 mpaka maola angapo.
REPAIR.SYNCFROMSTARTINFO: Chotsani mafayilo anu a blockchain akumaloko ndikuyanjanitsanso kuchokera ku block ya genesis.
REPAIR.RESTARTCOREINFO: Yambitsaninso Metrix Core ngati ikugwira ntchito kale kapena yambani Metrix Core ngati ikugwira ntchito.
REPAIR.REINSTALLCOREINFO: Chotsani Metrix Core yanu yapafupi ndikuyiyikanso kuchokera ku ma seva a Metrix.

BACKUP.ENABLED: Konzani zokha zosungira za wallet.dat pa nthawi yake
BACKUP.ENABLEDINFO: Imapanga kopi yatsopano ya fayilo yanu ya chikwama pa nthawi yake, kotero kopi yatsopano nthawi zonse imapezeka ngati china chake chalakwika.
BACKUP.NEVERBACKEDUP: Palibe zosunga zobwezeretsera zokha zomwe zapangidwa panobe.
BACKUP.LOCATIONINFO: Kumene ma backups odziyimira pawokha amasungidwa. Amasanduka chikwatu chosungira mkati mwa chikwatu cha deta cha chikwama chanu.
BACKUP.PRUNEINFO: Ma backups akale odziyimira pawokha amachotsedwa kuti chikwatu ichi chisakule kwamuyaya - ndi omwe aposachedwa kwambiri omwe ali pansipa okha omwe amasungidwa.

EXPLORER.BLOCKEXPLORERINFO: Tsambali linatsegulidwa poyang'ana malonda pa block explorer (monga kudina-kumanja pa malonda > Onani pa Explorer).
EXPLORER.TOKENDISCOVERYINFO: Utumiki wongowerenga wokha womwe umagwiritsidwa ntchito kupeza ma tokeni a MRC20/MRC721 omwe adilesi ya chikwama yakhala ikugwira ntchito. Ndalama zomwe zili ndi umwini zimatsimikiziridwanso nthawi zonse motsutsana ndi daemon yanu musanawonetsedwe kapena kugwiritsidwa ntchito - izi zimagwiritsidwa ntchito kokha kupeza ma tokeni oti muwone.

DEVELOPER.DEVMODEINFO: Kuzimitsa mwachisawawa ndipo cholinga chake ndi cha opanga mapulogalamu okha. Kuyimitsa izi kukuwonetsani njira zochotsera kulumikizana kwa RPC - ogwiritsa ntchito wamba ayenera kusiya izi.
DEVELOPER.WARNING: Zokonda izi ndi zachitukuko chokha. Kuzisintha kungalepheretse chikwamacho kulumikizidwa ku daemon - gwiritsani ntchito izi pokhapokha ngati mukudziwa zomwe mukuchita.
DEVELOPER.RPCHOSTINFO: Mwachisawawa, Altitude imalumikizana ndi daemon yomwe imadziyendetsa yokha, pa makina awa (127.0.0.1). Kuchotsa izi kumalola kuti ilumikizane ndi daemon ina m'malo mwake - mwachitsanzo remote regtest instance, popanda kufunikira kuyendetsa imodzi kwanuko. Ngati kulumikizanako kukuyenda bwino, Altitude sidzatsitsa kapena kuyambitsa daemon yakeyake. rpcallowip ya daemon yomwe mukufuna iyenera kulola kulumikizanaku, ndipo rpcuser/rpcpassword yomwe ili pansipa iyenera kufanana ndi kasinthidwe kake. Imagwira ntchito nthawi yomweyo, palibe kuyambiranso komwe kumafunika.

PROMPT.CLIENTSTOPPEDINFO: Kulumikizana kwa Metrix Core kwatayika. Mutha kuyimitsa chikwama kapena kuyambitsa Metrix Core yamkati.
PROMPT.ENCRYPTEDCONTENT: Ma backups aliwonse omwe mudapanga kale a fayilo yanu ya chikwama ayenera kusinthidwa ndi fayilo yatsopano yopangidwa, yobisika. Pazifukwa zachitetezo, ma backups akale a fayilo ya chikwama yosabisika sadzakhala othandiza mukangoyamba kugwiritsa ntchito chikwama chatsopano, chobisika.
PROMPT.CLIENTCLOSEDUNEXPECTEDINFO: Panali vuto ndi Metrix Core lomwe lachititsa kuti ithetsedwe. Ndikofunikira kuti muyang'ane fayilo yanu ya debug.log kuti muwone ngati pali mavuto.
PROMPT.CLIENTUNKNOWNERRORTITLE: Cholakwika cha Kulankhulana kwa Metrix Core
PROMPT.CLIENTUNKNOWNERRORINFO: Panali vuto polankhulana ndi Metrix Core. Ndikofunikira kuti muyang'ane fayilo yanu ya debug.log kuti muwone ngati pali mavuto.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPFAILEDTITLE: Chingwe cha Metrix Core Bootstrap Chalephera
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPFAILEDINFO: Panali vuto potsegula Metrix Core. Ndikofunikira kuti muyang'ane fayilo yanu ya Altitude log kuti muwone ngati pali mavuto.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPOFFERINFO: Pali bootstrap yaposachedwa yomwe ingathandize Metrix Core kusintha nthawi yomweyo. Kupitiliza ndi kusinthasintha kwabwinobwino m'malo mwake kungatenge masiku angapo kuti kumalizidwe, chifukwa chikwama chanu chikufunika kutsitsa ndikutsimikizira block iliyonse yomwe yasowa.
PROMPT.BOOTSTRAPSPACEINFO: Palibe malo okwanira pa disk kuti mutsitse ndikutulutsa bootstrap. Zofunika: {zofunikira}, Zikupezeka: {zaulere}. Tulutsani malo pang'ono ndikuyesanso.
PROMPT.STARTUPFAILEDINFO: Panali vuto poyambitsa Metrix Core. Ndikofunikira kuti muyang'ane fayilo yanu ya Altitude log kuti muwone ngati pali mavuto.
PROMPT.CLIENTINVALIDCONFIGINFO: Metrix.conf yanu ili ndi masternode yosavomerezeka yomwe ingapangitse Metrix Core kutuluka nthawi yomweyo. Chonde onani fayilo iyi.
PROMPT.UNENROLLGOVERNORCONTENT: Kodi mukutsimikiza kuti mukufuna kuchotsa Bwanamkubwa wanu paudindo? Simudzathanso kuvota pa kayendetsedwe ka unyolo.
PROMPT.DAPPCONNECTINFO: Tsambali likufuna kulumikizana ndi chikwama chanu cha ndalama ndikuwona adilesi yanu ndi ndalama zomwe muli nazo.
PROMPT.DAPPSENDINFO: Tsambali likupempha kutumiza mgwirizano kuchokera ku chikwama chanu.
PROMPT.DAPPSIGNINFO: Tsambali likupempha kuti musayine uthenga ndi adilesi yanu ya chikwama.
PROMPT.DAPPNOTREADY: Sitingathe kulumikizana ndi tsamba lino - Metrix Core ikuyambiranso.
PROMPT.DAPPNOWALLET: Sitingathe kulumikizana ndi tsamba lino - palibe adilesi ya chikwama yomwe ilipo.

NOTIFICATIONS.EXPLORERURLRESET: Ulalo wa Explorer wabwezeretsedwa kukhala wokhazikika
NOTIFICATIONS.EXPLORERURLUNREACHABLE: Sindinathe kufika pa URL imeneyo - yang'anani ndikuyesanso

GOVERNANCE.NOTGOVERNORDETAIL: Mabwanamkubwa ali ndi udindo wovota pa bajeti ya mwezi uliwonse komanso kusintha kwa blockchain. Mutha kukhala Bwanamkubwa mwa kuyika chikole choyenera mu mgwirizano wa Utsogoleri.
GOVERNANCE.CONFIRMENROLL: Mukufuna kulembetsa ngati Bwanamkubwa. Izi zitumiza mgwirizano ndi chikole chofunikira ku mgwirizano wa boma. Mutha kusiya kulembetsa nthawi iliyonse.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL1: Mabwanamkubwa ali ndi udindo wovota pa bajeti ya mwezi uliwonse ndi kusintha kwa blockchain.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL2: Kuti mukhalebe Bwanamkubwa muyenera kutenga nawo mbali pa voti imodzi kapena kuposerapo masiku 30 aliwonse.
GOVERNANCE.ISGOVERNORDETAIL3: Ngati palibe chovotera, mutha kupitiriza kulembetsa kwanu mwa kutumiza ping yogwira ntchito.
GOVERNANCE.NOTFULLYSYNCEDDETAIL: Mkhalidwe wanu wolembetsa ku Governor udzawonekera pamene blockchain yanu yalumikizidwa mokwanira.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO: Metrix blockchain ikusinthidwa kukhala DGP. Muyenera kuchotsa mgwirizano wakale wa DGP ndikulembetsanso watsopano. Ngati muli ndi Bwanamkubwa wakale ndiye kuti mudzawona batani lochotsa mgwirizano patsamba lino.
GOVERNANCE.DGPMIGRATIONINFO2: Kulembetsa kwatsopano kwa DGP kudzatheka mukangoyambitsa ntchito ya onchain. Discord yathu idzakhala ndi zambiri zaposachedwa pa izi.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1TITLE: Mtundu wakale wa DGP Kuchotsa Kulembetsa
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO1: Batani lomwe lili pansipa lidzachotsa mtundu wanu wakale wa Governor ndikubweza chikole chanu.
GOVERNANCE.UNENROLLV1INFO2: Mukamaliza kuchotsa kulembetsa kwanu, njira iyi idzatha.

LIST.TITLE: Zizindikiro
LIST.EMPTYTITLE: Palibe Zizindikiro Zomwe Zapezeka Pakadali Pano
LIST.EMPTYDETAIL: Kutalika kumayang'ana kokha block explorer ya ma tokeni a MRC20 ndi MRC721 omwe atumizidwa ku ma adilesi anu, kenako kutsimikizira chilichonse chomwe chikuchitika motsutsana ndi node yanu. Muthanso kuwonjezera tokeni pamanja ngati mukudziwa adilesi yake ya mgwirizano.
LIST.EMPTYDETAILCHECKINGDISABLED: Kuyang'ana ma tokeni okha kumazimitsidwa, kotero ma adilesi anu sakuwunikidwa ngati ali ndi ma tokeni. Yatsaninso pamwambapa, kapena onjezani tokeni pamanja ngati mukudziwa adilesi yake ya mgwirizano.
LIST.NONENUMERABLETOOLTIP: Zosonkhanitsazi sizithandiza kulemba zinthu payokha - kusonyeza kuchuluka kwa zinthu zomwe muli nazo m'malo mwake.
LIST.CHECKINGENABLEDTOOLTIP: Kuyang'ana zizindikiro kumayatsidwa - Kutalika nthawi ndi nthawi kumafufuza maadiresi anu kuti awone ngati zizindikirozo zili ndi ma tokeni ndipo kumawonetsanso ndalama zomwe zili mu akaunti yanu. Dinani kuti muzimitse.
LIST.CHECKINGDISABLEDTOOLTIP: Kuyang'ana zizindikiro kwazimitsidwa - dinani kuti muyatsenso.
LIST.CHECKINGDISABLEDNOTICE: Kuyang'ana ma tokeni okha kwazimitsidwa. Ma adilesi anu sakusanthulidwa kuti apeze ma tokeni ndipo ndalama zomwe zili mkati sizisinthidwa. Mutha kuwonjezera tokeni pamanja.

ADDTOKEN.TITLE: Onjezani Chizindikiro
ADDTOKEN.DESCRIPTION: Lowetsani adilesi ya mgwirizano wa chizindikiro cha MRC20 kapena MRC721 kuti muwonjezere pamndandanda wanu wa zizindikiro.
ADDTOKEN.NOTFOUND: Adilesi iyi sikuwoneka ngati mgwirizano wa MRC20 kapena MRC721 wothandizidwa.
